summary: Iteration 6 full-surface test of Fish It Autopilot web app (Telegram engine intentionally untested). Backend: 29/29 pytest live-API tests pass (health, auth register/login/me + negative cases, automation config GET/PUT persistence incl. boost_* + extra_allowed_chats + join_button_text, per-user config isolation, mode validation, status/events/notifications, read-all, start 400-guard, start/stop, pause/resume, telegram status + validation, admin users/stats/RBAC/plan update). Frontend: admin login -> Status dashboard, all 7 nav pages (Status, Telegram, Konfigurasi, Activity Log, Notifikasi, Paket, Kelola User) render without crash, 'Filter Chat & Boost' section with all requested data-testids present, boost toggle + cooldown + extra chats + join button saved and persisted after reload, Telegram setup form renders, new-user UI registration works, admin nav hidden + /dashboard/admin guarded for non-admin, logout clears fishit_token, unauthenticated /dashboard redirects to /login. No console errors except the expected 400 from Start without config.

minor.issue: Only validates bot/group username; does not verify a connected Telegram session. Returns 200 and the engine loop then throws 'API ID / API Hash belum di-set' repeatedly in backend logs. Suggest returning 400 with 'Hubungkan Telegram dulu' when telegram session/api creds are missing.
passlib bcrypt version warning: "module 'bcrypt' has no attribute '__about__'" (harmless, but noisy; pin passlib/bcrypt compatible versions).

issues: 'UPTIME' shows a bare yellow dash placeholder when automation is idle - reads as a broken bar; consider '-' text or 'Tidak aktif'.
Large empty area below the 3 stat cards on 1920x1080; no footer/content fills the viewport.

action_items: Optional: guard POST /api/automation/start on a connected Telegram session so users get a clear error instead of a silent failing engine loop.
Optional: split /app/backend/automation_engine.py (1112 lines) into smaller modules (client/session, message parsing, cycle orchestration).
Optional polish: Status page uptime placeholder and empty-state layout.
critical_code_review_comments: automation_engine.stop() caught only Exception around asyncio.wait_for(self.task), so uvicorn's lifespan cancellation surfaced as 'Application shutdown failed. Exiting.' on every backend restart. FIXED by catching (Exception, asyncio.CancelledError); verified clean 'Application shutdown complete.' after restart.
automation_engine.py is 1112 lines - exceeds the 700-line guideline; should be modularized.
automation_routes.start uses `not cfg or not cfg.get('group_username') and not cfg.get('bot_username')` - precedence works but is hard to read; wrap the AND in parentheses.
PUT /api/automation/config accepts a full AutomationConfig body (client must send every field); a partial/PATCH model would be safer against client-side field drops.
All queries correctly project out _id; no ObjectId leakage found. Admin endpoints correctly enforce role and never expose password_hash.
seed_data_creation: Several throwaway users prefixed test_ / TEST_ created via /api/auth/register (test_iter6_*, TEST_iso_*, TEST_start_*, TEST_tg_*, TEST_nonadmin_*, TEST_plan_*, test_ui_*). Admin config left with boost_cooldown_seconds=555, boost_enabled=false, extra_allowed_chats = the 4 VIP bots.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live API suite is /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_live_api.py (run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter6_live_api.py`). Telegram MTProto login cannot be tested (no real api_id/api_hash) - send-code failure is expected. Frontend testids: login-email/login-password/login-submit, nav-status|telegram|config|activity|notifications|pricing|admin, config-page + input-extra-allowed-chats/input-boost-command/input-boost-trigger/input-boost-cooldown/switch-boost-enabled/input-join-button/save-config, telegram-page + input-api-id/input-api-hash/save-creds, sidebar-user-email/sidebar-logout. Token key: fishit_token.
rca_of_the_issue: Backend restart failure RCA: uvicorn cancels the lifespan task on shutdown; automation_engine.shutdown() -> runner.stop() awaited asyncio.wait_for(self.task) whose CancelledError (a BaseException since Python 3.8) escaped the `except Exception` handler, aborting the shutdown context. Fixed by catching asyncio.CancelledError as well; verified with supervisorctl restart backend.
